idea: Feelings & kindness – SHARING (THE BEACH, picnic blanket): the lid of Baby Jimmy's little yellow picnic box pops open and TWO big red strawberries bounce up right beside his face ('Wow! Look! Two strawberries!'); chorus 'Share, share! Sharing is caring!'; Daddy Tom kneels down and shows his empty hands ('Oh! Daddy has none! Hmm...'); Jimmy gives him one – 'One for you! One for me!'; copy-me 'Hold out your hand! Here you go!'; 'Daddy says thank you! Yum, yum, yum!'; Jimmy asks the viewer 'What do we do? Hmm?' (pause) – 'We share! Sharing is caring! Yay!'; lesson 'One for you, one for me!'. Loop: the hook framing again, the box open and empty, Jimmy and Daddy waving bye-bye.
title: Wow! Two Strawberries! 🍓 Sharing Is Caring with Baby Jimmy | Good Habits for Kids | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! Baby Jimmy finds two yummy strawberries at the beach! 🍓 But Daddy Tom has none… Sing along as Jimmy learns to share: one for you, one for me!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! Two strawberries!" – a surprise picnic box at the beach
🎵 Share, share! Sharing is caring!
🙁 Oh! Daddy has none…
🍓 One for you! One for me! – Jimmy shares with Daddy
🤲 Hold out your hand with Jimmy: here you go!
😋 Daddy says thank you! Yum, yum, yum!
🤔 "What do we do?" – can you answer?
👋 We share! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: sharing with others • kind words: share, one for you, one for me, thank you • being kind to family

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun sing-along sharing song for toddlers and preschoolers, with Baby Jimmy sharing his strawberries with Daddy Tom on a sunny beach.
